tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Siyakwamukela, mholi omusha. Nginguye uSensei Hoshi. Isizwe sethu sithole isigodi esifihlekile ezintabeni. Masakhe isigodi okungekho mbangi engasithola.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Isigayo Sezinhlamvu sakho senza izinhlamvu. Uma uhlamvu luntanta phezu kwaso, luthinte, bese uthinta u-Qoqa.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Isizwe siphila ngezinhlamvu. Thinta u-Yakha bese ubeka Isigayo Sezinhlamvu.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Manje qinisa Inqaba Yesizwe: thinta inqaba, bese uthinta u-Thuthukisa.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Ukuthuthukisa kuthatha isikhathi. Inqaba izolunga kungakapheli isikhathi esingu-{time}: buya ngaleso sikhathi, noma uthinte u-Qeda manje ukuze usebenzise ijeyidi elincane.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Izizwe eziyizimbangi zizosigasela. Yakha Umbhoshongo We-Kunai eduze kwenqaba (Yakha, bese uthinta ithebhu ethi Ukuvikela): udubula noma yimuphi umgaseli osondele.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Yakha Idojo Lokuqeqesha, Igceke Lamaqembu noMbhoshongo We-Kunai eduze kwenqaba (Yakha: ithebhu ethi Ibutho, bese ithebhu ethi Ukuvikela).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Vula iphaneli ye-Ibutho bese uqeqesha ama-Shinobi: izinkemba ezisheshayo ezihlasela isakhiwo esiseduze kakhulu.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Ukuqeqesha nakho kuthatha isikhathi: amaqhawe akho azolunga kungakapheli isikhathi esingu-{time}. Linda, noma uthinte u-Qeda ukuqeqesha ukuze usebenzise ijeyidi elincane.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Ukugasela kwakho kokuqala. Thinta u-Hlasela, ubheke okuhlosiwe, bese uthi Hlasela! Enkundleni yempi ngizokukhombisa into eyodwa ngesikhathi: ngenisa ama-Shinobi akho ngephuzu elikhanyayo, bese uwafaka entuthwini lapho efika embhoshongweni: amaqhawe angaphakathi entuthwini angadutshulwa kuphela uma umuntu eseduze.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: Ulwe kahle. Thuthukisa Idojo Lokuqeqesha ukuze uvule Abonakalisi: bamisa isivikelo imizuzwana embalwa. Qala ngokumisa, bese uyahlasela, futhi ufake amaqhawe akho entuthwini lapho umlilo unamandla khona. Qoqa, thuthukisa, gasela, futhi ujoyine Umfelandawonye.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Umklomelo owodwa ngosuku, ofanayo kubo bonke, ongakhethwa ngenhlanhla futhi ongathengiswa. Uma weqa usuku akukho okulahlekayo: umklomelo olandelayo uwusuku olulandelayo ohlwini. Usuku lwama-28 lunika ukubukeka kwenqaba.

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Iminikelo ekhethekile ayiveli ngokuzumayo kubadlali abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18. Konke okusethebhini yeJeyidi kuhlala kutholakala ngaphakathi komkhawulo wakho wokusebenzisa imali.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Ukulethwa kuqala ngokushesha: inkokhelo yokuqala ingathathwa manje bese enye usuku ngalunye; ngokuthenga uyavuma ukuthi ulahlekelwa ilungelo lokukhansela, njengoba umthetho uvumela kokuqukethwe kwedijithali.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Ukuthenga akutholakali njengamanje. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhathi.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Ukuthenga akuphumelelanga. Uma ukhokhisiwe, kuzolethwa ngokushesha lapho isitolo sikuqinisekisa.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Alikho iqhawe elilwile, ngakho kubalwa njengokuzijwayeza.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Lolonga yonke into ethi {building} ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ibanga lidubula kude kodwa lishaya kancane futhi liqala ngamaqhawe angemuva; Ukuqhuma kushaya amaqembu kodwa kudubula kancane; Ukulinda kuqinisa Umbhoshongo Womnsalo Wesibhakabhaka, Isitofu Sentuthu Ebabayo nezicupho. Abagaseli bayabona ukulolongwa lapho behlola.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}
temper.left.text: {n, plural, one {kusele iphuzu elingu-#} other {kusele amaphuzu angu-#}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Ukulinda kuphinde kwenze buthaka ukwelapha kwabagaseli, ukuvuselela, ukuqina nokuvikelwa yizihlangu kuyo yonke inqaba.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Memezela umphumela ngaphambi kokuhlasela: uwufinyelele bese uthwala impango eningi ekhaya, uwuphuthe bese ungathwali lutho.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: Isibambiso siphuthiwe: umemezele {stars}★, ngakho ayikho impango efike ekhaya.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Iqembu lakho lithwale impango engu-{pct}. Amaqembu anezindima eziningi athwala okuningi.

raid.rejected.conflict.en: The opponent changed at the same moment.

raid.rejected.version_mismatch.en: This version of the game is too old.
